title: Remarks at El Moro, Colorado
paragraphs: It has been a great pleasure to me to get into Colorado to-day. I had to get up this morning at six, because I had some friends including two members of my regiment who met me at the first station at half past six. Now I have met three more. I have been meeting some of the boys who were down at [?] Santiago. I want to say what a pleasure it has been to have you come to greet me. When I get here in the west I feel thoroughly at home. I know you, and I believe in you with all my heart. (Applause)
